title: syntax-elements (chapter 14 §14.4.0)
description: One entry per syntax element read, sorted by (unit, bit_offset). bit_offset counts from the start of the unit's RBSP including the NAL header (H.26x) or from the first OBU payload bit (AV1; OBU header fields are negative), matching BitSpan of chapter 0 §0.5.1.

file_byte.description: --epb-offsets only: file offset of the byte holding the element's first bit

file_bit.description: --epb-offsets only: bit within that byte, 0 = most significant
